arStrings.szText: Lightning damage leaves enemies magnetized for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds causing them to emit {c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}, and increasing all Lightning damage they take from you by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c}. If two magnetized enemies hit each other with {c_important}Crackling Energy{/c} they pull each other together.
